jurisdiction: General assessment; used in Nebraska valuation practice
summary: Adjustment to improvement cost or value for loss in utility, condition, age, functional inadequacy, or external market factors.
plain_language: Depreciation is how the system accounts for a building not being worth the same as brand-new cost.

relationships.note: Condition and quality influence depreciation modeling.

source_refs.citation: IAAO, Standard on Mass Appraisal of Real Property.
